answer: Each agent earns one vote only after several distinct, bonded validators attest to it at a trust vertex. Forging a crowd of Sybils therefore means buying many independent vouchers, each backed by its own locked stake. A validator caught vouching for two keys sharing one controller loses its entire bond into a public nebula pool. The ferrous cost of an attack is the sum of all those bought attestations plus the certain slashing of every colluding backer, making a thousand fake agents far dearer than one honest one.
